goal: Allow users to disable periodic transaction rebroadcasts without disabling initial broadcasts
Prevents leaking wallet identity and transaction ownership to connected peers
agreement: No reviewers have explicitly endorsed the PR yet
Asked if rebroadcasting can be disabled safely and suggested extending -walletbroadcast instead (w0xlt)
Objected that defaulting rebroadcast to off hurts convenience, author open to keeping it on (vicjuma)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it lets users prevent periodic announcements that leak transaction ownership to all peers
Users previously could not disable periodic rebroadcasts without also disabling initial broadcasts
